description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmploymentStatusDaoTest' for testing the 'EmploymentStatusDao' data access object in the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup routines, multiple test methods for CRUD operations, and uses mock or test data. The tests validate retrieving, saving, editing, deleting, and counting employment statuses.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing methods of EmploymentStatusDao, including retrieval, deletion, search, save, and count operations related to employment statuses.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of EmploymentStatusDao, and populates test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentStatusesList
methods.description: Tests fetching the list of employment statuses; expects 3 entries.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentStatusById
methods.description: Tests retrieving an employment status by ID and verifies its name.

methods.name: testDeleteEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests deletion of employment statuses by IDs and verifies number of deletions.

methods.name: testSearchEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests searching employment statuses with default filter parameters; expects 3 results.

methods.name: testSearchEmploymentStatusWithLimit
methods.description: Tests searching employment statuses with a limit; expects 2 results.

methods.name: testSaveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new employment status with a name, verifying the object and name.

methods.name: testEditEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests editing an existing employment status by ID, changing name, and verifying the update.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentStatuses
methods.description: Repeats retrieval of employment statuses, expecting 3 entries and correct class instances.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmploymentStatusesCount
methods.description: Tests retrieving the count of employment statuses matching a search filter; expects count 3.
